function.name: getErpStatus
function.description: Check Inteckno ERP gateway health, active environment (prod/sandbox), and live record counts across all modules. Call this first in a session.

function.name: getErpSchema
function.description: Retrieve the Inteckno ERP relational map, Firestore partition layout, and Closed-Loop Information Highway rules. Call before querying unfamiliar modules or executing actions.

function.name: getErpModuleData
function.description: Read condensed, paginated, and filtered records from any Inteckno ERP module or sub-entity. Always specify 'fields' and 'limit' to save context tokens.

cursor.description: ID/code of last item from previous page

function.name: getErpSummary
function.description: Get ultra-condensed financial and operational KPIs across Inteckno ERP or for a specific projectCode.

function.name: runErpDiagnostics
function.description: Run automated forensic integrity checks across all Inteckno ERP modules (detects missing ITEM 01 folders, orphan POs/SOLPEDs, costCenter mismatches, missing HR salaries).

function.name: executeErpAction
function.description: Execute a Zod-validated business transaction that propagates across the Inteckno ERP Information Highway. In prod, only non-destructive deep merges are allowed.
